text:
hugo: Announcing GA for Archival Locks & Legal Hold for Private deployments effective today :lock: This gives customers an enforceable, tamper-evident way to prevent deletion or rotation of audit artifacts for a defined hold period. Docs and rollout plan below.

lia-legal: This was validated for eDiscovery and EU controller obligations. Note: legal hold does not bypass customer data-scope policies; it prevents removal but respects export controls.

rachel-support: Support note: when customers enable a legal hold, create a ticket with label "lab:archival-hold" and include cluster id and hold identifier. Holds can be admin-created or triggered via API.

ops-eng: rollout: pilot clusters today (opt-in), early access in 72h, full GA in 8 days. Feature is opt-in per-cluster and per-artifact type (logs, bundles, kv-checkpoints).

compliance-bot: [INFO] Controls mapped to retention evidence for ISO/SOC. Audit trail includes who created the hold, justification, duration, and cryptographic proof.

hugo: Implementation notes: holds are enforced by an on-node policy engine that marks objects immutable and appends a signed manifest. Manifests contain SHA256 hashes and can be exported for legal review.

ops-eng: known limits: immutable objects increase storage accounting; estimate additional storage 0.2-1% depending on hold volume. Holds cannot be removed without an explicit release workflow that requires multi-party approval if enabled.

hugo: example config (private-config.yaml):
```yaml
archival_hold:
  enabled: true
  default_hold_days: 365
  multi_approver_release: true
  approver_count: 2
  artifact_types:
    - audit_logs
    - local_bundles
    - kv_checkpoints
  manifest_signer: customer_key  # options: customer_key | redwood_attest
  retention_exemptions: []
```

rachel-support: Playbook: for accidental hold requests, open "lab:archival-hold" ticket and include justification docs. Release requests must include approver emails and hold-id. We will not bypass customer-configured multi-approver policy.

deploy-bot: [RELEASE] archival-locks v1.0 deployed to canary Private clusters at 3300001150.

lia-legal: Compliance reminder: for customers in strict jurisdictions, advise storing manifests in-region and enabling customer_key signing.

hugo: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/private/archival-locks (internal). We'll host two demos tomorrow 09:00 and 16:00 PT.

ops-eng: monitoring: hold-count, release-request-rate, manifest-verification-failures. We'll post daily summaries for first 7 days.

hugo: Thanks all — shout if you need a customer-facing one-pager or security FAQ. :rocket:
